chapterTitle: Chapter 19 Aldehydes and Ketones: Nucleophilic Addition Reactions
title: Problem 19-8

pages.text: PROBLEM 19-8 The oxygen in water is primarily (99.8%) 16O, but water enriched with the heavy isotope 18O is also available. When an aldehyde or ketone is dissolved in 18O-enriched water, the isotopic label becomes incorporated into the carbonyl group. Explain. R2C O + H2O ⇌ R2C O + H2O    where O = 18O
